capabilities: Group open checkboxes by note into board cards
Move note cards between Now, Later, Someday, and Inbox lanes
Order individual tasks in a separate drag-sorted queue
Complete or open tasks from the board, updating the source Markdown
Search tasks and customize lane names, colors, and queue background
extras: Renamed from plugin ID task-overview; on first launch it copies data from the old plugin's data.json. Local-only: no accounts, network requests, telemetry, or databases. Numbered checkboxes (1. [ ]) are not recognized; task identity relies on local fingerprints, so ambiguous edits can lose lane or queue position.
problem: Obsidian keeps checkboxes only inside notes, so there is no way to group tasks by note and arrange them across priority lanes or a custom order.

relations.evidence: When upgrading from the earlier plugin ID task-overview, disable that plugin first.

summary: Board view that groups open Markdown checkboxes by note into four lanes, plus a manually ordered task queue.
